attempts.exactPrompt:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Calu Ulenen: 30-year-old man, 162 cm (short), soft rounded construction with an evident middle and gentle limb contours, skin value band-1-lightest. Face: soft rectangular face; small bright eyes and fine straight brows; broad low bridge, full lips; one brow notch. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: multicolor-split-streak, short-textured-crop, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: fitted-vest-system, specifically a fitted cloth vest system over a soft shirt, high-waist trousers, and flexible boots; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette lilac-smoke. Visible personal details: three hair rings; a tiny nose stud. Make one clasp, buckle, piercing, or piece of hair hardware the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: low-maintenance grooming with highly polished footwear. Color treatment: balances one confident color field against quiet neutrals. Pose cue: feet plant evenly while fingertips touch a small personal keepsake. Include a string-bound recipe leaf only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme. Do not copy the reference's person, braid, clothes, pose, palette, progression, identity, body, hair, garments, ornaments, or markings.

RESERVE ACTIVATION: This is a fresh base summon, not an edit or regeneration of any existing hero. Create the new identity described above using only the authorized rendering-style reference. Honor the complete activated physical manifest and reserve character kernel; no failed hero or failed candidate is a visual source.

findings.observation: Exactly one coherent adult man appears with one head, two natural arms and hands, two legs and feet, and no duplicated body or anatomy.
The complete cropped hair, head, both hands, recipe leaf, divided vest hem, trousers, both polished boots, and grounding shadow remain fully inside generous canvas margins.

Visible brush planes, simplified skin and textile texture, controlled illustrative edges, warm parchment wash, and soft grounding shadow establish a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing rather than photography, plastic 3D, or cel anime.

The band-1 adult man, soft rectangular face, small bright eyes, fine brows, broad low nose bridge, full lips, split black-and-lilac short crop, tiny single nose stud, lilac-smoke fitted vest, soft shirt, high-waist trousers, flexible polished boots, divided hem, broad collar, and one string-bound recipe leaf are legible. However, the figure reads long-legged and lean with a narrow middle rather than 162 cm short and soft-round with an evident middle and gentle limb contours; four visible gold hair rings appear instead of exactly three; and the required one brow notch is not legible.
The mouth is closed and unsmiling, with a calm guarded gaze and no grin or theatrical expression.

The cloth vest, shirt, trousers, recipe leaf, small hair hardware, piercing, belt, and polished boots remain ordinary mortal details; no weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, logo, watermark, or text appears.

The new light-skinned adult man, short split-color crop, lilac-smoke fitted vest and trousers, recipe-leaf gesture, and grounded pose do not reproduce the style reference's woman, long braid and shave, ochre-ivory robes, body, pose, progression, or ornaments.
